programme.title: 家有囍事2009

programme.title: 长空之王

programme.title: 旺角监狱
To Live and Die in Mongkok
programme.desc: 辉(张家辉 饰) 是仁义社的杀手，旺角是仁义社的地盘为尽江湖手足情，辉便代替兄弟箭猪(韦家雄 饰)去斩杀廿多名黑道中人当年往逮捕细辉的探员枪王余 (廖启智 饰)碰到他，吓得屁滚尿流，连警枪都跌了本来，辉要置他于死地，但讲道义的细辉，见枪王余这样可怜，放他一马，却反被枪王余在他背后轰了一枪，不单受伤，还被拘捕下狱三十年可是，辉亦因此成为仁义社的英雄，旺角的传奇！出狱后，辉已和社会脱节，回到面目全非的旺角，差点连回家也不懂受精神分裂症影响，他以为永远也逃不出旺角，就像置身于监狱一样在旺角的黑道上，他出手救了来自内地的一对姊妹，其中妹妹是弱智的，却惹来不少麻烦 好不容易回到旺角老家，发现已年迈母亲患上老人痴呆症，连自己儿子也认不到...有一天，辉母突然清醒与辉相认，却于同一天逝世 辉为营救这对落难姊妹，招来了杀身之祸，黑白两道狂追猛打...

programme.title: 不日成婚 2
Ready O/R Rot

programme.title: 第一炉香
Love After Love

programme.title: OMG! 阿妈有喜
OMG! Mom's Big News

programme.title: 海关战线

programme.title: 破风

programme.title: 湄公河行动

programme.title: 他从火光中走来
Bright Eyes in the Dark
programme.desc: 林陆骁拥有过人的消防技巧和丰富的消防经验，是北浔市特勤一站站长因缘际会下，他被选中成了一档旨在科普消防知识的真人节目的教官在节目中林陆骁偶遇自己多年前从火场中救下的舞蹈演员南初南初对林陆骁充满好感，但林陆骁却因深知自己职业的危险而不愿靠近年轻而勇敢的新一代消防员如邵一九秦十全等崭露头角，从国外带回先进装备技术的楼明冶也回到了消防队老中青三代消防员们在火灾地震空中救援等灾情救援中通力合作，将北浔市的消防安全水平提升了一个台阶南初与林陆骁也在逐渐深入了解中确定了自己的心意，面临最危险的森林火灾，林陆骁与他的队友们依然选择逆火前进

programme.desc: 林陆骁拥有过人的消防技巧和丰富的消防经验，是北浔市特勤一站站长因缘际会下，他被选中成了一档旨在科普消防知识的真人节目的教官在节目中林陆骁偶遇自己多年前从火场中救下的舞蹈演员南初南初对林陆骁充满好感，但林陆骁却因深知自己职业的危险而不愿靠近年轻而勇敢的新一代消防员如邵一九秦十全等崭露头角，从国外带回先进装备技术的楼明冶也回到了消防队老中青三代消防员们在火灾地震空中救援等灾情救援中通力合作，将北浔市的消防安全水平提升了一个台阶南初与林陆骁也在逐渐深入了解中确定了自己的心意，面临最危险的森林火灾，林陆骁与他的队友们依然选择逆火前进

programme.desc: 房仲业务安琪突然得知失联多年的父亲留了一间房子给她，不过却始终找不到父亲，房子空置许久，还传出有游民在里面暴毙就在此时，安琪接下了公司凶宅专案的任务，在她处理一桩桩事故屋的过程中，她逐渐打听到了父亲的下落Real estate agent Angel suddenly discovers that her long-lost father has left her a house. However, her father is nowhere to be found, and the house has been left vacant for a long time, rumoured to have vagrants dying inside. Just then, Angel is tasked to sell her companys haunted houses. As she deals with each case, she gradually learns about her fathers whereabouts

programme.desc: Meet a golden retriever that assuages anxiety and helps heal PTSD, a shepherd mix who rescues mudslide survivors, a pair of spaniels who sniff out underground water leaks, and a group of teacher's pets in the UK that assist children learning to read.

programme.title: Wild Pacific Rescue Season 1
programme.desc: Follow the team in healing and releasing a grumpy sea turtle, and then meet a sea lion with an unusual injury that must be taken by crane to the rescue centre. Find out how the vet aids an aging fruit bat and a community rescues a one-eyed seal pup.

programme.title: Surviving the Amazon Season 1
programme.desc: A jaguar stalks the riverbank. A venomous snake is on the move. A Colombian tarantula waits for night fall. Watch as these fierce predators prowl through the jungle and bite into their next great meal.

programme.title: Surviving the Amazon Season 1
programme.desc: It's not easy to fall in love in the jungle. Find out how these animals turn to strategic mating strategies in order to pass on their genes. Meet monkeys who like monogamy, a bird who rivals Casanova, and a spider who'll risk his life for love.

programme.title: Wildlife ER Season 2
programme.desc: Chase the team as they triage patients from a hoarding case, then free a tangled-up ibis with rescue officers Jo and Chantelle. Check on a baby koala that took a swan dive with vet Mel and play the waiting game with a deadly eastern brown snake.

programme.title: Macaque Island Season 1
programme.desc: Stand back when a brawl erupts after the Street Troop finds the Hill Troop on their turf. Assess Matnoor's poor parenting skills, see alpha wannabe Ajit make his move, then cool off as a heat wave pushes everyone to share the wealth in the forest.

programme.title: After the Wildfires
programme.desc: Examine fire's pivotal role in shaping Australia's natural world. Tour the devastation left by 2020's brutal bush-fire season, learn how climate change fuelled this watershed event, and chart the long-term recovery of the continent's wildlife.

programme.title: Battle of the Alphas Season 1
programme.desc: From the Amazon to the Andes, South America has some beautiful scenery. From guanacos sparring over grassland, to marine iguanas head-butting over a beachhead, to home-stealing hermit crabs, the quest for real estate causes a lot of conflict.

programme.desc: Welcome baby orangutan Topan, an orphan in need of a surrogate mom. Watch her learning journey in nursery school while her fellow students move through junior, senior, and wild-immersion schools. Meanwhile, 16-year-old Kasper preps for graduation.

programme.desc: Observe blossoming friendships and interspecies bonds in nursery school, and peek inside a bromance among junior-school buds Valentino, Yutris and Madara. See distractible Beni lean into his love of food and get a beating from a more-senior pupil.

programme.title: 他从火光中走来
Bright Eyes in the Dark
programme.desc: 林陆骁拥有过人的消防技巧和丰富的消防经验，是北浔市特勤一站站长因缘际会下，他被选中成了一档旨在科普消防知识的真人节目的教官在节目中林陆骁偶遇自己多年前从火场中救下的舞蹈演员南初南初对林陆骁充满好感，但林陆骁却因深知自己职业的危险而不愿靠近年轻而勇敢的新一代消防员如邵一九秦十全等崭露头角，从国外带回先进装备技术的楼明冶也回到了消防队老中青三代消防员们在火灾地震空中救援等灾情救援中通力合作，将北浔市的消防安全水平提升了一个台阶南初与林陆骁也在逐渐深入了解中确定了自己的心意，面临最危险的森林火灾，林陆骁与他的队友们依然选择逆火前进

programme.title: 型男大主厨

programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖每一期将有不同的主题：大明星來下廚由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；五分钟出好菜由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的

programme.title: Over Australia Season 1
programme.desc: From the vast, dry plains of the interior come some of Australia's most recognized imagery, such as the monolithic red rock of Uluru and the bounding red kangaroo. But how did the arid center of the continent come to be?

programme.title: Macaque Island Season 1
programme.desc: Stand back when a brawl erupts after the Street Troop finds the Hill Troop on their turf. Assess Matnoor's poor parenting skills, see alpha wannabe Ajit make his move, then cool off as a heat wave pushes everyone to share the wealth in the forest.

programme.title: After the Wildfires
programme.desc: Examine fire's pivotal role in shaping Australia's natural world. Tour the devastation left by 2020's brutal bush-fire season, learn how climate change fuelled this watershed event, and chart the long-term recovery of the continent's wildlife.

programme.title: Wildlife ER Season 2
programme.desc: Deal with duelling duckling roundups and find out if vet Karina calls in specialists to treat koala Spike's leg fracture. Get to the bottom of stomach issues plaguing baby echidnas Ping and Pong, and meet koala Jarrah, who seems to have lost his way.

programme.title: Becoming Orangutan Season 1
programme.desc: Welcome baby orangutan Topan, an orphan in need of a surrogate mom. Watch her learning journey in nursery school while her fellow students move through junior, senior, and wild-immersion schools. Meanwhile, 16-year-old Kasper preps for graduation.

programme.title: Becoming Orangutan Season 1
programme.desc: Observe blossoming friendships and interspecies bonds in nursery school, and peek inside a bromance among junior-school buds Valentino, Yutris and Madara. See distractible Beni lean into his love of food and get a beating from a more-senior pupil.

programme.title: Battle of the Alphas Season 1
programme.desc: With real-life dueling dragons, giant sumo-wrestling beetles, street-fighting monkeys, and sea turtles that play king of the hill on top of another sea turtle, Southeast Asia boasts a wide range of wildlife warriors.

programme.title: My Best Friend's An Animal Season 2
programme.desc: Check in on Elsa the sloth with Pedro, who has dedicated his life to her care after a fall left her paralyzed. Learn why Thor the wolf welcomed his human, Steve, into his pack, then watch Kristen and Beau make life accessible for Crystal the raccoon.

programme.title: My Best Friend's An Animal Season 2
programme.desc: Learn to swim with Ozzy the otter and his coach, Leslie, then see how Petronel has earned the trust of Riri the rhino orphan, who was traumatized by poachers. Sniff out land mines with Kobe the rat and free-dive with Gaia the hammerhead shark.

programme.desc: A Labrador cross and its partner help prevent ecological disaster in Canada, a Lagotto Romagnolo unearths a rare delicacy in Washington forests, and a Belgian malinois team tracks down the critically endangered geometric tortoise to save the species.

programme.title: Over Australia Season 1
programme.desc: Created by titanic forces and spanning 3,700 km along the eastern edge of Australia, the Great Dividing Range separates two very different worlds. Aerial footage and intimate studies reveal how species survive and thrive in this mountain home.

programme.title: Becoming Orangutan Season 1
programme.desc: Welcome baby orangutan Topan, an orphan in need of a surrogate mom. Watch her learning journey in nursery school while her fellow students move through junior, senior, and wild-immersion schools. Meanwhile, 16-year-old Kasper preps for graduation.

programme.title: Becoming Orangutan Season 1
programme.desc: Observe blossoming friendships and interspecies bonds in nursery school, and peek inside a bromance among junior-school buds Valentino, Yutris and Madara. See distractible Beni lean into his love of food and get a beating from a more-senior pupil.

programme.title: Wildlife ER Season 2
programme.desc: Contend with a flood of abandoned koala joeys, then join vet nurse Nick on a hunt for natural remedies to treat a wallaby's gut ailment. Ponder options for a baby bat stuck in a tree and look on as vet Karina operates on a barn owl's fractured wing.

programme.title: My Best Friend's An Animal Season 2
programme.desc: Check in on Elsa the sloth with Pedro, who has dedicated his life to her care after a fall left her paralyzed. Learn why Thor the wolf welcomed his human, Steve, into his pack, then watch Kristen and Beau make life accessible for Crystal the raccoon.

programme.title: My Best Friend's An Animal Season 2
programme.desc: Learn to swim with Ozzy the otter and his coach, Leslie, then see how Petronel has earned the trust of Riri the rhino orphan, who was traumatized by poachers. Sniff out land mines with Kobe the rat and free-dive with Gaia the hammerhead shark.

programme.title: Battle of the Alphas Season 1
programme.desc: The USA is big on flash and spectacle. Bighorn rams rattle the mountaintops. Brown bears battle, desperate to fatten up for winter. Sharp-tailed grouse shake their tail-feathers on the dance floor. Wild stallions rumble with beauty and grace.

programme.title: Reef Wrecks Season 1
programme.desc: This island of the coast of Honduras stands out as a vacation resort hot spot. But it's not just the sun and sand that brings the tourists in droves. It's actually a diver's paradise with shipwrecks scattered from all corners of the the island.

programme.title: Deep in the Heart
programme.desc: Take a journey through the eyes of catfish, ocelots, and other native creatures with narrator Matthew McConaughey. Celebrate the Lone Star State's landscapes and wildlife, and learn how crucial conservation efforts can save Texas' unique habitats.

programme.title: Into the Wild India Season 1
programme.desc: A young lion cub must survive as his family is torn apart; two adolescent leopard cubs must fend for themselves after they are abandoned, and a young adult blackbuck must risk life and limb as he tries to secure his first mating.

programme.title: Into the Wild India Season 1
programme.desc: Rajan is the powerful alpha male who sits at the head of an unusually large troop. He has done well to sustain such a big group, but the future doesn't look so bright. There are more mouths to feed, and yet his jungle home is shrinking.

programme.title: Into the Wild India Season 1
programme.desc: Nestled on the edge of the ancient city of Jodhpur, the luxurious Temple Gardens are home to a huge troop of Hanuman Langurs, who enjoy a peaceful life of bounty. But the troop has a strict hierarchy.

programme.title: Into the Wild India Season 1
programme.desc: In the hot forest of Southern India, a female King Cobra is on a mission: to find a mate, find food, and lay eggs before the monsoon arrives.

programme.title: Into the Wild India Season 1
programme.desc: In southern India, the summer is a challenge for Asian elephants who must drink every day. As things dry up, Anura, the matriarch, leads her herd to a distant watering hole. But will she succeed in getting her 3-month-old grandson there in time?

programme.title: Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs Season 1
programme.desc: Dogs around the world come to the rescue in surprising ways. Some search for survivors when disaster strikes or rescue animals from poachers and wildlife traffickers. Others help us in times of troubleboth on land and in the water.

programme.title: Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs Season 1
programme.desc: Meet a border collie that protects aircraft from lethal bird strikes, a sprocker spaniel whose sense of smell is saving imperilled water voles, and an Anatolian shepherd that helps conserve Africa's most endangered big cat, the cheetah.

programme.title: Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs Season 1
programme.desc: Meet a golden retriever that assuages anxiety and helps heal PTSD, a shepherd mix who rescues mudslide survivors, a pair of spaniels who sniff out underground water leaks, and a group of teacher's pets in the UK that assist children learning to read.

programme.title: Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs Season 1
programme.desc: A blind woman has found a new lease on life thanks to her canine running mate, a Jack Russell works as a super-nanny to a surprising array of species, and a team of dogs in Kenya are on daily patrol protecting endangered rhinos from poachers.

programme.title: Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs Season 1
programme.desc: A Labrador cross and its partner help prevent ecological disaster in Canada, a Lagotto Romagnolo unearths a rare delicacy in Washington forests, and a Belgian malinois team tracks down the critically endangered geometric tortoise to save the species.

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1
programme.desc: Bask in the awe-inspiring strength of the animal kingdom's most powerful creatures. Smash through rock-hard termite mounds with silverback gorillas, see jaguars that can crush caiman skulls, then head to the ocean to witness orcas hunting in packs.

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1
programme.desc: Hit the gas with Earth's fastest animal athletes. Watch death adders strike in the blink of an eye, do airborne assassinations with peregrine falcons, catch a quick meal with chameleons, and face breakneck G-forces as gannets dive-bomb their prey.

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1
programme.desc: Experience animal abilities that are beyond human reach. See how saltwater crocodiles detect the tiniest movement with their pressure-sensitive domes, discover a pigeon's internal GPS system, and use a seventh sense to detect prey with dolphins.

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1
programme.desc: Deploy biochemical weaponry with nature's most cunning and resilient fighters. Unleash venomous bites with Komodo dragons, resist poisonous foes with mongoose mobs, and see birds use bone-crushing force to counter poisonous attacks.

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1
programme.desc: Bow down to one of nature's most ancient and deadly endurance predators. Watch tiger sharks exploit turtle nesting chaos, survive oxygen-poor environments with epaulette sharks, and withstand the crushing pressure of the deep with ghost sharks.

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1
programme.desc: Prowl the ocean with sharks of all kinds and see why these predatory fish reign supreme under the sea. Stalk coral labyrinths with reef sharks, lie in wait for the perfect strike with wobbegongs, and embark on epic migrations with great whites.

programme.title: In for the Kill
programme.desc: Marvel at the clever ways predators use cunning, agility, and breakneck speed when taking down prey. Witness luring behaviours and see how some killers hide in plain sight, while others put weaponry or chemical warfare to work to bring dinner home.

My Country, My Parents

programme.title: 逆鳞
Untouchable

programme.title: 梅兰芳
Forever Enthralled

programme.title: 秘密访客
Home Sweet Home
programme.desc: 一场惨烈的校车车祸，导致几乎全部学童丧生司机拼命救回一名男孩，却令自己失去部分记忆男孩的父亲为答救命之恩，把司机带到自家地下室里与他们共同生活司机渐渐发现这家人的行为诡秘，众人的异常更似乎与那场车祸有关

programme.title: 窗前明月，咣！
Out of Order
programme.desc: 顶级律师的秘密幽会，却因酒店房间里离奇出现的一具尸体，瞬间沦为无法回头的噩梦为了掩盖真相，他的每一步都让一切变得更加混乱

programme.title: 阿龙

programme.title: 猎金游戏
A Gilded Game
programme.desc: 野心勃勃的金融高材生高寒，适逢好友的家族企业正筹备在香港上市，因而被引荐进入投行实习在首席分析师张托德的带领下，高迅速崭露头角，却因野心作祟而背叛恩师，转投竞争对手当好友的家族企业被敌意收购时，为了弥补过失，高恳求张相助，连手阻止这场恶意收购

programme.title: 合家辣
Chilli Laugh Story

programme.title: 边缘行者

programme.title: 出租家人
We are Family
programme.desc: 沉迷于演戏的临时演员志光，加入由家聪与立志成为女演员的佩怡一起成立的出租家人公司，变成出租临时家人当他们出演临时家人服务时，发现家庭成员间的复杂关系，并建立更深入的联系

programme.title: S风暴
S Storm
programme.desc: 廉政公署首席调查主任陆志廉在调查非法足球搏彩集团时目击嫌疑犯被杀重案组督察刘保强急需陆志廉的口供，但因廉署的保密守则，陆志廉无法提供任何线索，阻碍刘保强的调查二人由调查开始时的互不信任，到最后发展出默契，誓要将犯罪集团连根拔起

programme.title: 西游记之大闹天宫

programme.desc: 女娲娘娘化成万千五彩晶石补天，其中一颗晶石迸出了孙悟空孙悟空武功高强，不知天高地厚竟挑战玉皇大帝，搞得天宫一片混乱，无意间让牛魔王乘虚而入，欲攻陷天宫重振魔族声威

programme.title: 全城地图：最强明星队
The Best Team
programme.desc: 全城地图：最强明星队是一运动竞技实境节目，由钱薇娟与江宏杰分别领军蓝红两队，以城市为竞技场，穿梭全台进行团队对抗该节目以将城市化为竞技场为概念，集结好手争夺最强明星队荣耀The Best Team is a sports reality competition programme where Taiwan national athletes and celebrities take part in Blue and Red teams respectively, using cities as their battlegrounds, travelling across Taiwan and compete against one another. Based on the concept of turning cities into arenas, the programme brings together top athletes to vie for the title of the ultimate celebrity team.

programme.title: 型男大主厨
Stylish Man
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖每一期将有不同的主题：大明星來下廚由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；五分钟出好菜由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的

programme.title: 烈焰
Burning Flames
programme.desc: 故事讲述王子武庚拥有神族和人族的双重血脉，天资不凡，桀骜不驯然辛国被神族覆灭，父母离世，高高在上的王子沦为奴隶武庚在困境中历经磨难，与市井少女白菜和一群志同道合的朋友相识，带领人族集结神隐部妖族海灵族等，携手对抗强大的神族武庚不断磨砺成长，从国仇家恨到为天下苍生而战，不断成长强大，成为天之战神

programme.title: 好事成双
Alliance
programme.desc: 曾是一流大学高材生的林双，婚后迅速怀孕成了全职妈妈，但为家庭全身心付出的她遭遇背叛离婚在即，为了争夺女儿的抚养权，林双不得不重返职场面对婚姻职场亲情的种种考验，林双在好友江喜的支持下迎难而上，而背地里施以援手的旧同学顾许也忍不住对林双动心林双用实际行动完成了从家庭主妇到职场人的转变，也收获了和顾许的美好爱情，迎来属于自己的新生活

programme.desc: Deploy biochemical weaponry with nature's most cunning and resilient fighters. Unleash venomous bites with Komodo dragons, resist poisonous foes with mongoose mobs, and see birds use bone-crushing force to counter poisonous attacks.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Season 2
programme.desc: Get tangled up in breeding season with Mick and Adele, who save a Jack Russell from a peckish python. Make a splash with Mick as he corners a deadly red-bellied black snake in a pool, and tackle eastern browns at a construction site with Stu and Liv.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Season 2
programme.desc: Gear up for a steamy rescue when Dan and Jess remove mating eastern browns from a backyard, then hold your breath as Mick sniffs out a highly venomous snake inside a couch cushion. Later, watch Stu cut up a chicken coop to pry out a carpet python.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Season 2
programme.desc: Head to a resort, where Stu and Liv try to capture a pregnant red-bellied black snake in view of holiday makers. Watch Mick and Adele nab a lace monitor lizard that's chasing a chicken dinner, then catch a slippery garage intruder with Jess and Dan.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Season 2
programme.desc: Get messy with Stu and Liv, who try to outwit a large blue-tongued lizard. Race the clock with Jess and Dan as they try to rescue a pregnant snake before one serpent turns into many, and see Mick and Adele keep a python away from two playful puppies.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Season 2
programme.desc: Engage in a battle of wills with Adele and Mick as they try to coax a python out of a drainpipe. Stand by as Jess and Dan try to grab a keelback snake before it drops a stink bomb, then face a dangerous serpent hidden in a university wall with Stu.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit Season 2
programme.desc: Kick back as Mick and Adele break up a pair of mating eastern brown snakes at a retirement home. Take care of unwanted inventory with Stu and Liv, who capture a green tree snake in a warehouse, then sneak up on a killer visitor with Jess and Dan.

programme.title: Macro Worlds Season 1
programme.desc: As soon as the days get cold and dark insects begin to disappear from the meadows and fields. Their sum and hum slowly fades away and will finally be gone. All animals have their special ways to survive winter. Migrating birds like swallows and cranes fly towards south, a lot of mammals like deer get a thick winter fur or hide away and sleep where it's warm. But what do insects do? And why are they all back in spring?

programme.title: Macro Worlds Season 1
programme.desc: It is horror! It is murder! Brutal death as well as exciting fights with an exceptional last-minute rescue. And after seeing it you will know the creepiest spot is actually the meadow in your neighborhood. With stylistic devices from the horror genre this extraordinary nature documentary takes you on a journey following a well-known hero with six legs, red wings and seven black dots through a seemingly normal meadow but full of monsters.

programme.title: Macro Worlds Season 1
programme.desc: Beetles have inhabited the Earth for more than 240 million years. There are around 380,000 kinds of beetles known to scientists and every year hundreds of new species are discovered. One fourth of the world's animals are beetles. They have conquered almost every corner and every habitat on the planet and they have survived every global disaster. What is it that makes them so successful?

programme.title: Battle of the Alphas Season 1
programme.desc: Wildebeest battle for herd hierarchy, meerkats live the thug life, floppy fish fight it out on land and locusts give up their vegetarian ways in a frenzy of cannibalism. It all happens on the wild and wide-open landscape of South Africa.

programme.title: Ningaloo: Australia's Ocean Wonder Season 1
programme.desc: Observe the natural and human forces that have shaped Ningaloo Reef, Cape Range, and Exmouth Gulf with Tim, Traditional Owners, and other experts. Check out a million-year-old fossil reef, a gargantuan fish, and a ray that packs quite a punch.

programme.title: Ningaloo: Australia's Ocean Wonder Season 1
programme.desc: Follow scientists and Traditional Owners as they map out ecological links, migratory pathways, and interspecies bonds that conserve Ningaloo's biodiversity. Frolic with whales, float among seaweed islands, and see archaeologists nix a settler myth.

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1
programme.desc: Experience animal abilities that are beyond human reach. See how saltwater crocodiles detect the tiniest movement with their pressure-sensitive domes, discover a pigeon's internal GPS system, and use a seventh sense to detect prey with dolphins.

programme.title: Animals Like Us Season 1
programme.desc: Learn how to disarm and dine on scorpions with meerkat pups in the Kalahari Desert and review a lioness' flirting strategy in Kenya. Meet same-sex penguin couples who are raising chicks together, then sign up for an Asian elephant babysitters' club.

programme.title: Animals Like Us Season 1
programme.desc: Go rogue with frigate birds, who steal meals from smaller seabirds; relax in a mongoose-run spa with a grateful warthog; and decode an African elephant's secret message. Then watch lovelorn capuchin monkeys hurl rocks to attract prospective mates.

programme.title: New Kids in the Wild Season 2
programme.desc: Test limits with jaguar cub Frida, who's honing her survival skills in Brazil's Caiman Lodge Reserve. Learn how to sneak with mum Gatuna, see sister Anouk help her hide from hungry interlopers, and go on a reckless solo trek that takes a lucky turn.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons Season 2
programme.desc: Winter in Marakele National Park is one of the scarcest, but also most plentiful, times of the year. See how a giraffe's demise becomes a source of life for the region's vultures, whose survival depends on the decaying flesh of animals like these.

programme.desc: 二十世纪初，各地劳动人口纷纷涌入高速发展之上海山东青年马永贞(伍允龙 饰)亦到上海当码头工人当时上海各帮派荼毒社会，其中较有正义感之龙七(安志杰 饰) 赏识马永贞胆识过人武技非凡二人惺惺相惜，成为好友龙七反对贩毒及向日军卖力，与斧头帮三大犯罪头子白癞痢(陈观泰 饰)笑面佛(袁祥仁 饰)仇老四(冯克安 饰)为敌，马永贞与他连手反毒，令三人怀恨于心马永贞与江湖卖艺的铁师父(洪金宝 饰)及其两个女儿铁梅(蒋璐霞 饰)铁菊(胡然 饰)成为邻居马永贞被铁菊的硬朗性格所吸引，而铁菊亦佩服马永贞的正义感，对他渐渐产生好感龙七则迷恋上歌女盛香君(毛俊杰 饰)，没想到日后竟因此而身陷险境斧头帮因不满龙七的嚣张跋扈，与日本间谍桥本密谋除掉他，龙七惨遭暗算马永贞的邻居亦遭受袭击，马永贞赶至时已尸横遍野，垂死的铁师傅告知铁菊被斧头帮掳走极度悲痛的马永贞为救铁菊，单人匹马闯入斧头帮老巢，决定用双手消灭国家的敌人社会的败类，为民除害!

programme.title: 被消失的凶案
A Murder Erased
programme.desc: 警长骆英财被派往调查被埋没八年的尸体发现案随着警长锁定疑犯，一名检控官也参与调查想要找出案件的真相在质问警长之下，检控官更发现他的行为有疑，因他对案件的陈述前后不一，充满疑点...

programme.title: 第一炉香
Love After Love
programme.desc: 电影由许鞍华导演，改编自张爱玲的首部短篇小说三十年代，年青女学生葛薇龙离乡别背井从上海到香港求学，因生活拮据，求助姑妈代交学费，却被姑妈利用，成为上流社会社交游戏的诱饵当她爱上花花公子乔琪乔时，正是她堕落的开始

programme.title: 焚城
Cesium Fallout
programme.desc: 因非法偷运废料引发的一场大火，香港陷入辐射泄漏危机为了应对这场毁灭性的灾难，专家范伟立加入由署理行政长官领导的紧急应变小组一支消防队伍临危受命，深入辐射区，拼尽全力阻止辐射扩散在面对前所未见的浩劫时，他们能否拯救这座城市？

programme.title: 唐探1900
Detective Chinatown 1900
programme.desc: 1900年代，美国旧金山唐人街发生白人女子命案，疑凶为一名中国男子此案引发社会公愤，并有人呼吁封闭唐人街唐人街神探孖宝秦与福阿鬼在危机四伏的环境中争分夺秒，誓揭真凶，还原真相

programme.title: 老狐狸
Old Fox
programme.desc: 1989年，年轻的廖杰和他的父亲为购房而存钱，却不知道房价正在飙升饱受贫困之苦，他向房东老狐狸学会在社会中求生存廖杰最终以所学伤害了老狐狸，但他的同情心终究使他没有成为另一个老狐狸

programme.title: 反贪风暴之加密危机
Crypto Storm
programme.desc: 廉政公署调查主任骆一峰成立一支特别小组，调查银行高层利用加密货币造市贪污的案件当银行主席遭绑架，绑匪要求以造市案有关的加密货币来支付赎金时，骆一峰相信造市案的幕后黑手与绑匪为同一人，于是誓要全力缉凶

programme.title: 向阳花
We Girls
programme.desc: 为了给女儿购买价值二十万元的人工耳蜗，高月香铤而走险，最终被判入狱意想不到的是，这段经历让她结识了三位女友人她们虽然性格各异，却结下深厚情谊，携手迎难而上，互相扶持，共同向阳而生！

programme.title: 阿龙

programme.desc: 阿龙与女儿相依为命，生活潦倒却依然乐观，深信好人有好报然而一次泰国之旅，女儿惨遭拐走信念崩塌的他为追寻线索不惜一切，暗中追查拐子集团，最终化身双手沾血的复仇者

programme.desc: 天道变数，石妖提前三百年破石而出，生存堪忧的石妖踏上了寻仙之路他在求仙路上九死一生，幸得金丝雀舍命相救，石妖因此许下了复活金丝雀的诺言为了实现诺言，石妖一路拜师修行，其间与天真烂漫的风铃和孤傲高冷的杨岚分别暗生情愫，还卷入了众妖与天庭的对抗之中A mortal man accidentally time-travels to the past and becomes the Monkey King. Unwilling to accept his fate, he embarks on a journey that brings him to face gods and demons.

programme.title: 天地剑心
Sword and Beloved

Trained as a Daoist soldier, Fu Gui lived a life without freedom. programme.title: 现在很美丽
It's Beautiful Now
programme.desc: 此剧讲述在回避恋爱和结婚的时代，李家三兄弟为了占据家庭长辈们留给他们的公寓而寻找伴侣的故事李庆哲是李家的祖父和精神领袖，年纪轻轻就成了鳏夫 在他最低谷的时候，收养了旻昊 与庆哲一样，旻昊和妻子都寄望于他们三个长大成人的儿子，三个体面的年轻人，都有一份不错的工作 庆哲向他的孙子们提出了一个提议， 第一个结婚的人会得到一套公寓 贤才是三个男孩中的第二个，是一名律师 润才是一位在该地区享有盛誉的牙医 秀才一边在包裹服务公司工作，一边为公务员考试做准备 三兄弟谁先结婚？

programme.title: 他从火光中走来
Bright Eyes in the Dark
programme.desc: 林陆骁拥有过人的消防技巧和丰富的消防经验，是北浔市特勤一站站长因缘际会下，他被选中成了一档旨在科普消防知识的真人节目的教官在节目中林陆骁偶遇自己多年前从火场中救下的舞蹈演员南初南初对林陆骁充满好感，但林陆骁却因深知自己职业的危险而不愿靠近年轻而勇敢的新一代消防员如邵一九秦十全等崭露头角，从国外带回先进装备技术的楼明冶也回到了消防队老中青三代消防员们在火灾地震空中救援等灾情救援中通力合作，将北浔市的消防安全水平提升了一个台阶南初与林陆骁也在逐渐深入了解中确定了自己的心意，面临最危险的森林火灾，林陆骁与他的队友们依然选择逆火前进

programme.title: 灼灼韶华

programme.title: 奔跑吧特别篇 5
Keep Running Special Season 5
programme.desc: 奔跑吧特别篇 5着重于中国一些偏远和少为人知的地点城市，通过创新游戏设置，增加艺人与当地民众的互动，同时激发大众对奔跑的渴望对温暖的传递和对美好的追求，以综艺化的特色表达传递正能量节目还是由奔跑吧固定MC班底 - 超人气大卡艺人继续担纲主持任务

programme.title: 绝命法官
Justice Is Mine
programme.desc: 在二十世纪九十年代初的濠港，法官秦誉与高级督察唐萱二人曾联手将社团头目韩奎龙成功定罪然而秦誉之子意外撞伤韩家长子后，他陷入法理与亲情的两难抉择，最终竟选择伪造证据，为掩盖真相不惜伪造证据嫁祸他人，从法律的守护者坠落为规则的挑战者，将罪责嫁祸给一名偷车少年随着唐萱深入追查这起案件，官商勾结的暗流警界内部的腐败，以及多桩陈年旧案的隐秘关联也逐渐浮出水面，勾勒出一幅复杂的年代罪案图景Qin Yu, who used to be an upright judge, covered up the truth that his son caused an accident and injured the son of a gang leader in a traffic collision. To avenge his son, the gang leader stirred up a storm of bloodshed.

programme.desc: 在二十世纪九十年代初的濠港，法官秦誉与高级督察唐萱二人曾联手将社团头目韩奎龙成功定罪然而秦誉之子意外撞伤韩家长子后，他陷入法理与亲情的两难抉择，最终竟选择伪造证据，为掩盖真相不惜伪造证据嫁祸他人，从法律的守护者坠落为规则的挑战者，将罪责嫁祸给一名偷车少年随着唐萱深入追查这起案件，官商勾结的暗流警界内部的腐败，以及多桩陈年旧案的隐秘关联也逐渐浮出水面，勾勒出一幅复杂的年代罪案图景Qin Yu, who used to be an upright judge, covered up the truth that his son caused an accident and injured the son of a gang leader in a traffic collision. To avenge his son, the gang leader stirred up a storm of bloodshed.

programme.title: Ningaloo: Australia's Ocean Wonder Season 1
programme.desc: Follow scientists and Traditional Owners as they map out ecological links, migratory pathways, and interspecies bonds that conserve Ningaloo's biodiversity. Frolic with whales, float among seaweed islands, and see archaeologists nix a settler myth.

programme.title: Animals Like Us Season 1

programme.desc: 全民才藝真人秀節目，圍繞主題聚焦不同類型達人進行同主題表演；邀請了謝霆鋒鄧紫棋孟非伊能靜組成觀察團，從各自的專業知識與觀察視角出發，深入百姓生活，挖掘值得點贊的才藝與故事

programme.title: 一夢如初(短劇)
A Dream LikeTheTrue Love (Mini drama)
programme.desc: 少女陳寶銀為救母親，無奈被卷入命運洪流，從青樓逃落後幾經輾轉成為船娘；在她最落魄時重逢曾救過她的書生溫肅，此時溫肅已家道中落，為救家人忍辱成為長公主的男寵；兩個身處泥潭的底層男女在亂世中相互取暖彼此救贖，上演了一段充滿破碎感卻又堅韌動人的愛情故事

programme.title: 黑月光法則(短劇)

programme.title: 十天之後回到現實
Tenday
programme.desc: 沉浸式生存闖關綜藝連續劇，邀請了吳奇隆陳妍希侯明昊林更新沈月等39位來自各行各業的高能闖關者，在真實城市中進行10天不間斷的全封閉生活，經歷腦力體力心理博弈團隊協作等遊戲關卡挑戰，最終所有關卡通關，勝出的人成最後的大贏家

programme.title: 我們的歌 第六季

programme.desc: 節目煥新升級，打破原有賽制，以聽世界的聲音，唱我們的歌為主題，廣邀了劉宇寧毛不易馬嘉祺古巨基李克勤騰格爾龔琳娜等三十多位歌手平行演繹，回歸音樂本質，共同打造融合金曲，為歌手之間的合作與交流提供更多的可能性，打造充滿無限活力的音樂盛宴

programme.title: 遊遍江蘇 第4季

programme.title: 極限挑戰 第十季

programme.desc: 在二十世纪九十年代初的濠港，法官秦誉与高级督察唐萱二人曾联手将社团头目韩奎龙成功定罪然而秦誉之子意外撞伤韩家长子后，他陷入法理与亲情的两难抉择，最终竟选择伪造证据，为掩盖真相不惜伪造证据嫁祸他人，从法律的守护者坠落为规则的挑战者，将罪责嫁祸给一名偷车少年随着唐萱深入追查这起案件，官商勾结的暗流警界内部的腐败，以及多桩陈年旧案的隐秘关联也逐渐浮出水面，勾勒出一幅复杂的年代罪案图景Qin Yu, who used to be an upright judge, covered up the truth that his son caused an accident and injured the son of a gang leader in a traffic collision. To avenge his son, the gang leader stirred up a storm of bloodshed.

programme.title: 玉茗茶骨
Glory
programme.desc: 年轻状元郎陆江来上任淳安县令后屡破奇案，却因卷入一桩杀妻旧案，从官场新星沦落至绝境濒死之际，幸得茶王之女荣善宝搭救两人联手整顿家族开拓茶道，在茶园里缔结了一段爱情佳话的故事After rising star magistrate Lu Jiang Lai is brought down by a past wife-murder case, hes left injured and on the run, only to be rescued by Rong Shan Bao, the Tea King's daughter. programme.title: 白色橄榄树
The White Olive Tree
programme.desc: 梁城卫视女记者宋冉在动荡的东国执行采访任务时突遇危险，所幸被在东国做志愿者的华裔爆破工程师李瓒相救，李瓒的温柔和心怀大爱的赤子之心深深吸引了宋冉李瓒在与宋冉的多次相处中，也发现这个女孩外表看似柔弱，其实勇敢坚强，内心充满了正义与善良相同的理想和契合的灵魂，让两人擦出了爱的火花然而，一场突发的爆炸袭击将这份刚刚萌生的感情画上了休止符回国后的两人都陷入了人生的低谷，甚至彼此失去了联系李瓒因为好友在爆炸袭击中为救自己而牺牲感到内疚自责，宋冉则由于在爆炸袭击中拍摄的一张照片而备受争议，两人都承受着身心的双重伤痛机缘巧合下他们重逢，渐渐各自的生活走回了正轨，他们一起种下了白色橄榄树种子

programme.desc: 在二十世纪九十年代初的濠港，法官秦誉与高级督察唐萱二人曾联手将社团头目韩奎龙成功定罪然而秦誉之子意外撞伤韩家长子后，他陷入法理与亲情的两难抉择，最终竟选择伪造证据，为掩盖真相不惜伪造证据嫁祸他人，从法律的守护者坠落为规则的挑战者，将罪责嫁祸给一名偷车少年随着唐萱深入追查这起案件，官商勾结的暗流警界内部的腐败，以及多桩陈年旧案的隐秘关联也逐渐浮出水面，勾勒出一幅复杂的年代罪案图景Qin Yu, who used to be an upright judge, covered up the truth that his son caused an accident and injured the son of a gang leader in a traffic collision. To avenge his son, the gang leader stirred up a storm of bloodshed.

programme.title: Animals Like Us Season 1

programme.title: Coral Reefs
programme.desc: Corals build themselves homes of limestone in the warm, clear, shallow seas of the tropics. Their reefs occupy less than one tenth of one per cent of the ocean floor, yet they are home to a quarter of all known marine species. They are complex, infinitely varied structures providing all kinds of homes for their many residents. There is fierce rivalry for space, for food and for a partner, but the reef is also a place full of opportunity.

programme.desc: From sensible chuckles and nervous giggles to Duggee's infectious laughter, once everyone starts, it's so hard to stop. What were they laughing about again? Anyone remember?

programme.title: Eugene's Animal Chorus
programme.desc: Eugene gives an unexpected performance with help from some talented animals! Mooo!

programme.title: Say Cheese
programme.desc: The Squirrels learn about butterflies and tortoises.

programme.title: White Cliffs of Dover, England
programme.desc: Glitch tries to teach the Grimbots by drawing on a chalkboard. Before he can finish, his last piece of chalk snaps and the grumpy Grandmaster demands the Grimbots find a fresh supply. Meanwhile, the Go Jetters arrive at the White Cliffs of Dover in England, to cheer Kyan as he finishes a cross-channel swim, but a large cloud of dust blocks his way to the shore. On the beach, Lars and Foz find the Grimbots mining the cliffs with a big drill, causing a big crack to spread across the rock face. Can

programme.title: The Creek
programme.desc: Bored of the local playground, Dad and the kids go out bushwalking on a journey to their local creek. Cast out of her comfort zone, Bluey's eyes are opened to the beauty of the natural world.

programme.title: Circus
programme.desc: Bluey is the ringmaster in a game of circus with her friends, but Hercules wants to play his motorcycle game instead. Luckily Bluey has a solution to keep everyone happy.

programme.title: Omelette
programme.desc: Bingo is helping Mum make an omelette for Dad's birthday breakfast, but cracking eggs is harder than it looks, and Dad is getting hungrier by the minute.

programme.title: Born Yesterday
programme.desc: Dad pretends he was born yesterday. Bluey and Bingo have to guide him through his second day on Earth, especially when he discovers food is delicious and steals Lucky's Dad's pie.

programme.title: Andy and the Hungry Dinosaurs
programme.desc: Andy and Jen are throwing themselves a party to celebrate an epic year on Dino Island but discover that their prehistoric pals have been helping themselves to all the party food.

programme.title: Hoop
programme.desc: Bella and Lift visit the Cloud Kitchen, where Patch needs some help from the Playtimers to make hoopy owl bagels. It's time for a tasty adventure!

programme.title: Happy's First Day
programme.desc: Happy has always loved the water, even though it makes a mess. But while swimming around in his paddling pool at the playhouse, Duggee reminds the Squirrels that there was a time when Happy feared water.

programme.title: The Spot the Difference Badge
programme.desc: Duggee looks different, but what is it? By playing some looking games, the Squirrels learn how best to spot the difference.

programme.title: Roly's First Day
programme.desc: As Roly makes his usual noise in the Clubhouse, Duggee and the Squirrels reminisce about how completely different Roly was when he first arrived.

programme.title: Mount Etna, Italy
programme.desc: When Grandmaster Glitch makes popcorn in Mount Etna, Italy, he blocks the volcano and endangers farms on its slopes.

programme.title: The Taj Mahal, India
programme.desc: The grimbots attach a bit of the Taj Mahal to GrimHQ. It remains to be seen whether the Go Jetters can fix the glitch.

programme.title: Thomas Makes a Mistake
programme.desc: After Thomas makes a mistake with an important silk delivery in India, he causes chaos and confusion by not seeking help.

programme.title: Lost Librarian
programme.desc: The Librarian has lost his big reference book and Sarah thinks her toy periscope might help with the search.

programme.title: Scooter Stand Still
programme.desc: Scooter Boy gets his confidence knocked after a small accident, so Sarah and Duck help him to get it back.

programme.title: Power
programme.desc: Stanley needs to do some jobs for the community, but all his vehicles are out of power due to a cloud of butterflies obscuring them and he needs to figure out how to move them.

programme.title: Snow
programme.desc: It has snowed and almost no one can get about. Stanley builds a snow plough out of surf boards to clear the streets and makes a huge snow hill so that his friends can sledge down it.

programme.title: I'm Going To Cannonball In The Pool
programme.desc: Water fights, bodyboarding and ice cream. The funny little animals chat about going on holiday.

programme.title: It's Time To Open a Shop
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran visit Jared's shop, which really does stock everything, and everything has a place. When they get home, JoJo decides to open her own shop with her till and panda pounds. Having found lots of things that they can sell, JoJo is disappointed when she can't quickly find what her customers want to buy. Gran Gran has a plan, and soon everything has a place - perfect for JoJo and Gran Gran's customers Jared and Cynthia to find just what they want to buy.

programme.title: Space
programme.desc: Mackenzie, Jack and Rusty are playing as astronauts on a mission to Mars, but during their journey, Mackenzie keeps going missing and no one knows why, not even Mackenzie.

programme.title: Smoochy Kiss
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want Dad all to themselves and will not let Mum have a smoochy kiss. They try to hide him all around the house, but Mum is desperate to spend a little romance time with her husband.

programme.title: Dirt
programme.desc: Judo desperately wants to play in the dirt with Bluey and Bingo, but she is not supposed to get herself dirty.

programme.title: The Size Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels learn about atoms, molecules and cells to help understand sizing when they try to sort a line-up of things from smallest to biggest.

programme.title: The Getting Ready Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are getting ready for the same woodland adventure, but their mornings all look slightly different.

programme.title: Splash Dash
programme.desc: Duggie chooses a key and his blue digger to dig up a big bone. The chipmunk makes a delivery to the squirrels.

programme.title: The Blue Mountains, Jamaica
programme.desc: Trouble brews in Jamaica when Glitch's campfire threatens a coffee plantation.

programme.title: Orange
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's the daring Orange attempting to cross the stage on a tightrope, if she manages to ignore any distractions.

programme.title: Cucumber
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Cucumber performing Cool Under Pressure while trying to not let any obstacle ruin her calm routine.

programme.title: Speedy Pea
programme.desc: Evil Pea steals Supertato's brand new Tato Car but doesn't realise that the Grape Kids are in the back seat. Supertato has to get the Grape Kids back to safety and save his car.

programme.title: Ahoy Captain Pak Choi
programme.desc: Supertato and Broccoli go on a pirate adventure with Captain Pak Choi, but they don't realise she intends on plundering Evil Pea's freezer and stealing all her shiny things.

programme.title: The Carrot Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are admiring Duggee's crop of giant carrots when they hear a noise. They find the Rabbits busy preparing for the Carrot Solstice.

programme.title: The Face Painting Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are looking for Duggee but can't find him. Instead, they find someone they think is Enid, only much too big... Duggee has painted his face to look like Enid! Of course, the Squirrels want their faces painted too, so Duggee sets to it.

programme.title: The Transport Badge
programme.desc: When Duggee's old friend Rhodri goes home after a visit, he forgets his favourite hat. No worries, the Squirrels can run after him and give it back. They take all sorts of transport to catch Rhodri, and he is always one step ahead. Until finally, they're on a raft across the sea and land right by Rhodri's front door.

programme.title: The Talent Badge
programme.desc: Out for a walk, the Squirrels spot an interesting poster - it's King Tiger advertising his Roar Talent Show. Naturally, the Squirrels are very keen to take part. First, they need to find their talents. After they spend some time searching, Narrator explains that 'finding their talents' means working out what they are good at. So, the Squirrels practise their skills until they are ready to face an audience.

programme.title: The Mime Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is encouraging the Squirrels to come outside by gesturing through the window. They don't understand what he's doing and think it's funny. When he comes inside, a bit exasperated, he explains that he was miming. They want to know what miming is, and Duggee fondly recalls his days as a young Parisian street performer. The Squirrels are keen to learn how to mime, and Duggee runs them through the basics.

programme.title: Stick Together
programme.desc: Have you seen Duggee? Help the Squirrels search for him, but they need to stick together!

programme.title: Ready Or Not
programme.desc: Duggee looks all around, but can he find the Squirrels? Lets play Hide and Seek!

programme.title: Dr. Catastrophe
programme.desc: The Super Squirrels are called to action! Time to stop Dr Catastrophe and save their toys!

programme.title: El Gran Final
programme.desc: Join the chickens in space for the big finale of Agony and Eggstacy! Mucho Suspense!

programme.title: Night And Day
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered what goes on at the Squirrel Club when the sun goes down?

programme.desc: The Teletubbies enjoy doing 'Round and Round the Garden', especially the end of the rhyme where they all tickle each other. The Tiddlytubbies have tickly fun too.

programme.desc: The Teletubbies are back together like you've never seen them before!

programme.desc: Dad tries to teach Bluey how to play chess, but Mum thinks she is still too young. When Bingo joins in, the kids make up their own rules, but they still can't beat Dad.

programme.desc: Dad agrees to play Sheepdog with Bluey and Bingo to stop them from disturbing Mum who is taking a well-earned rest, but looking after a sheep is harder work than they expected.

programme.desc: Mum and Dad vow to only finish their boring housework when the kids stop acting silly, but that's never going to happen, so they end up trying the same approach themselves.

programme.desc: When a cold-ridden Glitch's sneezing breaks his TV, the Grimbots take him to the Virunga National Park in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to see a real mountain gorilla. programme.title: The Face Painting Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are looking for Duggee but can't find him. Instead, they find someone they think is Enid, only much too big... Duggee has painted his face to look like Enid! Of course, the Squirrels want their faces painted too, so Duggee sets to it.

programme.title: The Transport Badge
programme.desc: When Duggee's old friend Rhodri goes home after a visit, he forgets his favourite hat. No worries, the Squirrels can run after him and give it back. They take all sorts of transport to catch Rhodri, and he is always one step ahead. Until finally, they're on a raft across the sea and land right by Rhodri's front door.

programme.title: The Talent Badge
programme.desc: Out for a walk, the Squirrels spot an interesting poster - it's King Tiger advertising his Roar Talent Show. Naturally, the Squirrels are very keen to take part. First, they need to find their talents. After they spend some time searching, Narrator explains that 'finding their talents' means working out what they are good at. So, the Squirrels practise their skills until they are ready to face an audience.

programme.title: The Mime Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is encouraging the Squirrels to come outside by gesturing through the window. They don't understand what he's doing and think it's funny. When he comes inside, a bit exasperated, he explains that he was miming. They want to know what miming is, and Duggee fondly recalls his days as a young Parisian street performer. The Squirrels are keen to learn how to mime, and Duggee runs them through the basics.

programme.title: The Why Badge
programme.desc: All the Squirrels are having a fine old time playing with the hose. All except one, poor Tag whose feet hurt. 'Why do my feet hurt?', he asks Duggee. While Duggee has a think, he tells them 'why' is a great question, and the Squirrels are quick to follow up.

programme.title: Ready Or Not

programme.title: Peekaboo

programme.title: Magic

programme.title: Chest
programme.desc: Dad tries to teach Bluey how to play chess, but Mum thinks she is still too young. When Bingo joins in, the kids make up their own rules, but they still can't beat Dad.

programme.title: Sheep Dog
programme.desc: Dad agrees to play Sheepdog with Bluey and Bingo to stop them from disturbing Mum who is taking a well-earned rest, but looking after a sheep is harder work than they expected.

programme.title: Housework
programme.desc: Mum and Dad vow to only finish their boring housework when the kids stop acting silly, but that's never going to happen, so they end up trying the same approach themselves.

programme.title: Pass the Parcel

programme.title: Yong Bao and the Tiger

programme.title: Gordon and Rebecca - Coming Through!

programme.title: Kenji on the Rails Again
programme.desc: When Kenji hears that he must travel home to Japan alone, he gets scared and tries to hide. So, Thomas sets out to find him

programme.title: Mountain Gorillas, The Democratic Republic of the Congo
programme.desc: When a cold-ridden Glitch's sneezing breaks his TV, the Grimbots take him to the Virunga National Park in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to see a real mountain gorilla. But Glitch doesn't realise how dangerous his cold germs can be, so the Go Jetters will have to stop him from making a baby gorilla sick - all while trying to keep it safe from dangerous traps left by hunters.

programme.title: Go Jetter or No Jetter?

programme.title: Mariana Trench: The Pacific Ocean

Lars and Xuli must work together to mount a rescue operation at the bottom of the sea.

Kyan discovers a queue of cars making their way across the grass, with a Grimbot traffic warden directing them towards a huge Grim car park.

programme.title: The Spot the Difference Badge
programme.desc: Duggee looks different, but what is it? By playing some looking games, the Squirrels learn how best to spot the difference.

programme.title: Mount Etna, Italy
programme.desc: When Grandmaster Glitch makes popcorn in Mount Etna, Italy, he blocks the volcano and endangers farms on its slopes.

programme.title: Scooter Stand Still

programme.title: Music Fixer
programme.desc: Sarah's Tuba is making some very peculiar sounds, so a trip to the Music Shop is in order.

programme.title: Shipwreck

programme.title: Power
programme.desc: Stanley needs to do some jobs for the community, but all his vehicles are out of power due to a cloud of butterflies obscuring them and he needs to figure out how to move them.

programme.title: That Is SO Bad!
programme.desc: From being cheeky - like eating lots of sweets or watching TV when you're not supposed to - the funny animals chat about what it's like to misbehave.

programme.desc: Happy has always loved the water, even though it makes a mess. But while swimming around in his paddling pool at the playhouse, Duggee reminds the Squirrels that there was a time when Happy feared water.

programme.title: The Northern Lights, Finland
programme.desc: Ubercorn is excited to see the Northern Lights, but Glitch's Grunge-Grimbler covers them with smoke.

programme.title: Table Mountain, South Africa
programme.desc: Glitch wants to ski, so the Grimbots give Table Mountain a snowy peak, which threatens its rare plants.

programme.title: Diesel Glows Away
programme.desc: When notorious Diesel hides from the other engines, his plans backfire and he gets a surprise on Sodor.

programme.title: Music Fixer
programme.desc: Sarah's Tuba is making some very peculiar sounds, so a trip to the Music Shop is in order.

programme.title: Wool on Wheels
programme.desc: Scarf Lady is holding a 'knitted treats' sale in the park, but the weather is causing a problem...

programme.title: Den
programme.desc: Little Woo and Seamus call Stanley to help them build a den so they can watch the bugs in the forest without disturbing them. After some trial and error, Stanley builds a giant, camouflaged den on legs.

programme.title: Shipwreck
programme.desc: Benjamin and Hettie find an old treasure map that leads to Blue Whiskers' Pirate Shipwreck! They ask Stanley to help them find it and maybe bring it back to show the townsfolk.

programme.title: Your Brother is Really Naughty
programme.desc: The talking animals chat about all the good and bad things about having a brother or a sister.

programme.title: It's Time to Visit the Optician
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran take a trip to have JoJo's eyes tested at the opticians. Jaxon and Ezra help explain what it means to be long- and short-sighted. After his eye test, Jaxon is struggling to decide which glasses he would like to wear. JoJo really wanted to pick new glasses too, but she doesn't need them. Gran Gran has a plan: JoJo can help Jaxon pick his new glasses!

programme.title: Dirt
programme.desc: Judo desperately wants to play in the dirt with Bluey and Bingo, but she is not supposed to get herself dirty.

programme.title: The Decider
programme.desc: The Heelers and Lucky's family get together to watch the big game, a fun family experiences that gets a little tense.

programme.title: Cubby
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo build a very special cubby for their stuffed toy Kimjim.

programme.title: The List Badge
programme.desc: Duggee has lost the list he made for the Squirrel's activities for the day at Squirrel Club. After a quick lesson on what a list is, they are happy to help Duggee recreate his.

programme.title: The Wish Badge
programme.desc: Whilst helping Duggee clean up, the Squirrels come across an old lamp. Duggee explains that many years ago, when rubbed, it could grant three magical wishes.

programme.title: Stick Together
programme.desc: Have you seen Duggee? Help the Squirrels search for him, but they need to stick together!

programme.title: The Nazca Lines, Peru
programme.desc: The Go Jetters race to protect ancient artwork in Peru, when Glitch erases the Nazca Lines.

programme.title: Plum
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Plum performing the Sugar Plum Fairy Bounce and attempting to do not one, not two, but three pirouettes in midair!

programme.title: Corn
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Corn singing an A-maiz-ing Counting Song about his remarkably organised kernel rows.

programme.title: Veg-O-Vision Song Contest
programme.desc: Supertato and the Tato Team must battle to save Tato Tower from Evil Pea's earth-shaking stomping performance at the Veg-O-Vision Song Contest.

programme.title: Desserts of Destiny
programme.desc: Evil Pea lures Supertato and Tomato into her cave of frosted doom. Can they find the courage to avoid her traps and retrieve The Lost Candle of Birthdays for Tomato's Museum?

programme.title: Go Outside
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, LaaLaa and Po want to go outside but it's raining. Some wellies and umbrellas magically appear and the Teletubbies go outside for splashy, rainy fun.

programme.title: Duck
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say duck and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see lots of different ducks - a brown duck, a white duck and Dee even goes for a ride in a yellow duck boat! There are baby ducks, mother ducks and lots of funny ducks eating their dinner! The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way and everyone has a boogie when Dee's friend finally succeeds in saying today's word!

programme.title: Messy Races
programme.desc: Messy and friends enter a race in OKIDO and the various vehicles speed off! Who has the power to win the mystery prize?!

programme.title: The Swoppiton Duck
programme.desc: Mojo and Bo need Ted's help to pull a wobbly duck statue up Swoppiton Hill. But does Ted know the best way? And will there be anything left of the duck when they get there?

programme.title: Show and Tell
programme.desc: Bluey wants to know why Dad's always bossing her around.

programme.title: Stickbird
programme.desc: On a trip to the beach, Mum teaches Bluey to throw, while Bingo and Dad get creative with a funny shaped stick.

programme.title: The Transport Badge
programme.desc: When Duggee's old friend Rhodri goes home after a visit, he forgets his favourite hat. No worries, the Squirrels can run after him and give it back. They take all sorts of transport to catch Rhodri, and he is always one step ahead. Until finally, they're on a raft across the sea and land right by Rhodri's front door.

programme.title: The Face Painting Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are looking for Duggee but can't find him. Instead, they find someone they think is Enid, only much too big... Duggee has painted his face to look like Enid! Of course, the Squirrels want their faces painted too, so Duggee sets to it.

programme.title: Mysterious Milkshake
programme.desc: More fun with Duggee, biscuits, eggs, toys and of course milkshakes.

programme.title: Animals
programme.desc: The Squirrel club play games involving animals. The chickens do some rhythmic office work.

programme.title: Go Jet Academy: Wind Power
programme.desc: It's a very windy day at the Go Jet Academy as Jetpad comes in to land, zooming past the academy's windfarm turbines. Meanwhile, in a field nearby, Grandmaster Glitch is teaching his grimbots a lesson all about wind power by trying to fly a giant kite. But as the kite is launched, the strong wind catches it and pulls Glitch up, up and away - and straight towards a huge spinning turbine!

programme.title: Bumpy And The Wise Old Wolfhound
programme.desc: Bingo is sick in hospital, so Bluey and Dad sent her a homemade video to lift her spirits. It tells the tale of Barnicus' quest to heal her spotty dog named Bumpy.

programme.title: Postman
programme.desc: When Mum and Dad have a disagreement, Bluey makes Dad write a love letter to Mum to make up. Now Bluey must find a way to play Ground's Lava with Bingo and deliver the letter to Mum, without squabbling.

programme.title: Unicorse
programme.desc: Bluey can't get to sleep, so Mum reads her one last story. But they are interrupted by Unicorse, the most annoying hand puppet in the world, whom Bluey tries to reform.

programme.title: Curry Quest
programme.desc: Bingo and Dad must brave a swooping magpie protecting its nest, when they go on a curry swap to Mackenzie's house through the park.

programme.title: Andy and the Alamosaurus
programme.desc: Jen is carried away by a weather balloon and Andy sets out on an epic adventure across Dino Island to rescue her. Along the way, they meet the mighty Alamosaurus.

programme.title: Tubes
programme.desc: Bella and Lift enjoy making funny honk noises with tubes. They visit Tincy the Spider, who uses terrific tubes to make music with the Playtimers.

programme.title: The Hat Badge
programme.desc: King Tiger interrupts the Squirrels' quiet time when he turns up to the Clubhouse with a magic hat on instead of his crown.

programme.title: Tag's First Day
programme.desc: The Squirrels are crafting in the Clubhouse when Betty saves Tag from throwing water across the table instead of glitter.

programme.title: The Library Badge

programme.title: Amazon Rain Forest, South America
programme.desc: Glitch wants a picnic so he stops the rain in the rainforest, upsetting the local tree frogs.

programme.title: The Northern Lights, Finland
programme.desc: Ubercorn is excited to see the Northern Lights, but Glitch's Grunge-Grimbler covers them with smoke.

programme.title: Laid Back Shane
programme.desc: Shane is having too much fun to stop and refuel. That is, until he runs out of coal and is stranded in the hot, red desert.

programme.title: Wool on Wheels
programme.desc: Scarf Lady is holding a 'knitted treats' sale in the park, but the weather is causing a problem...

programme.title: Lemon Cafe
programme.desc: Sarah and Duck discover a Lemon Cafe in the park, but it seems to be nearly closing time...

programme.title: Flower
programme.desc: Fifi asks Stanley to help her find a new place for her friend Isabelle the Sun-bell Daisy. This proves trickier than initially planned as Isabelle has some specific needs.

programme.title: Den
programme.desc: Little Woo and Seamus call Stanley to help them build a den so they can watch the bugs in the forest without disturbing them. After some trial and error, Stanley builds a giant, camouflaged den on legs.

programme.title: My Grandad Sometimes Steals My Chocolate Buttons
programme.desc: From tickles and piggybacks to no longer being able to do cartwheels, grandparents are brilliant!

programme.title: It's Time to Dress Up
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran have fun finding Gran Gran's old clothes. When Charlene brings round a sewing machine, it's time for a Gran Gran plan - they can make JoJo some new clothes too!

programme.title: The Decider
programme.desc: The Heelers and Lucky's family get together to watch the big game, a fun family experiences that gets a little tense.

programme.title: Exercise
programme.desc: Dad thinks he needs to do some exercise, but Bingo pretends to be Boss Bluey's new employee in the middle of Dad's backyard workout.

programme.title: The Music Video Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are having fun playing a song they made, but they wish that they could see themselves perform. Duggee has a great suggestion, and they learn how to be creative.

programme.title: The List Badge
programme.desc: Duggee has lost the list he made for the Squirrel's activities for the day at Squirrel Club. After a quick lesson on what a list is, they are happy to help Duggee recreate his.

programme.title: Ready Or Not
programme.desc: Duggee looks all around, but can he find the Squirrels? Lets play Hide and Seek!

programme.title: The Paddy Fields of China
programme.desc: The Go Jetters swing into action when Glitch uses real landmarks for his crazy golf course.

programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Celery performing We're Here to Grow - if he manages to squeeze himself out of the dressing room on time.

programme.desc: Supertato invites Evil Pea to his sleepover, but Carrot is suspicious and vows to stay up all night to make sure she can't unleash any of her evil plans.
